app.name: StrollWay
app.tagline: Stair-free walks for families with a stroller

planner.empty: Set a start and an end on the map, or try a demo route.

form.hint: Click the map: the first click sets the start, the second the end.

bigDetour.title: Stair-free route: +{{detour}}, +{{minutes}} min
bigDetour.detail: The shortest route has <stairs>{{stairs}} of stairs</stairs>. Stair-free route: +{{detour}}, +{{minutes}} min.

tinyDetour.title: You can avoid the stairs with almost no extra distance.
tinyDetour.detail: The shortest route has <stairs>{{stairs}} of stairs</stairs>. The stair-free route is only +{{detour}}.

noStepFree.title: There is no stair-free route between these points.
noStepFree.detail: The route has <stairs>{{stairs}} of stairs</stairs>, marked in red on the map.

noStairs.title: No stairs on this route.
noStairs.detail: You can go with a stroller the shortest way.

notSearched.title: Stairs are not avoided.
notSearched.detail: The route has <stairs>{{stairs}} of stairs</stairs>, marked in red on the map.

checkFailed.title: We could not check for a stair-free route.
checkFailed.detail: Showing the shortest route. It has <stairs>{{stairs}} of stairs</stairs>, marked in red.

unknownStairs.title: This is a straight line, not a real route.
unknownStairs.detail: We do not know if it has stairs.

demoMode.fixture: Demo mode: a recorded route (no routing key, or the service did not answer).
demoMode.mock: Demo mode: a straight line, not a real route.

errors.noRoute: We could not find any walking route between these points.
errors.noRoutablePoint: A point is too far from a path or a street. Move it closer to a road.
errors.invalid: These points cannot be used. Put the end closer to the start.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while planning the route.

poi.title: Places on the way
poi.unavailable: The places service did not answer.
poi.none: There are no tagged places near this route in OpenStreetMap.

transit.title: Transit stops
transit.none: No tram or bus stops close to the start or the end.

empty.title: No saved walks yet.
empty.text: Plan a route and save it, or add a few sample walks.

walkForm.title: Save walk
walkForm.description: Give the walk a name and choose places to keep as stops.
walkForm.name: Name
walkForm.stopsHint: Choose up to {{max}} places from the route.
walkForm.noPlaces: There are no places on this route to add.
walkForm.paceMismatch: The walking time was planned with another profile. It is saved as it is; plan the route again with this profile to update it.

notFound.title: Walk not found.
notFound.text: It may have been deleted, or it was saved in another browser.

notes.label: Notes
notes.placeholder: What should you remember next time?

status.title: Status and rating
status.rateFirst: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 first.

delete.title: Delete this walk?
delete.text: "{{name}}" and all its stops will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

stops.title: Stops
stops.addHint: Click the map to place the new stop.
stops.pointSet: Point set. Click the map again to move it.
stops.name: Name (optional)

delete.title: Delete this stop?
delete.text: "{{name}}" will be removed from the walk.

errors.minutes: Give a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.noPoint: Click the map to place the stop.

profiles.intro: A profile sets the walking pace. It stores only ages, never names.

empty.title: No profiles yet.
empty.text: Add a profile to plan walks at your family's pace.

errors.noChildren: Add at least one child's age.
errors.ageInvalid: An age is a whole number from 0 to {{maxAge}}.

delete.title: Delete this profile?
delete.text: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Saved walks stay, without a profile.
